description: Fix the API Gateway v2 WebSocket autoDeploy/route race in lib/quiz-app-stack.ts so that EVERY WebSocket route ($connect, $disconnect, $default, and the 7 custom action routes) is guaranteed to be present in the deployed 'prod' stage on every `npx cdk deploy`, with no manual console 'Deploy API' needed. This resolves the realtime-battle 'connection error' where wss://.../prod fails with close code=1006 and NO $connect log reaches the ws Lambda (the request is dropped at API Gateway before integration because the auto-deployment was created before/without the routes). This is a single, self-contained CDK change plus test and README updates. lambda/ws.ts and the frontend are NOT touched.
steps: In lib/quiz-app-stack.ts, locate the section (c.2) realtime battle block that creates `wsApi` (apigwv2.WebSocketApi), the custom action routes loop (`wsApi.addRoute(action, ...)`), and `wsStage` (apigwv2.WebSocketStage with autoDeploy:true).

Make the route set explicit and capture every route object so a CloudFormation dependency can be attached. Replace the connectRouteOptions/disconnectRouteOptions/defaultRouteOptions built-ins with explicit `addRoute` calls (or additionally capture the built-in route child constructs) so that '$connect', '$disconnect', and '$default' each yield a WebSocketRoute you can depend on. Concretely: create `wsApi = new apigwv2.WebSocketApi(this, 'QuizWebSocketApi', { description: 'Realtime quiz battle WebSocket API' })` WITHOUT the *RouteOptions, then create ALL routes via addRoute: iterate over ['$connect','$disconnect','$default','createRoom','reattachRoom','joinRoom','startGame','submitAnswer','nextQuestion','endGame'] calling `const route = wsApi.addRoute(key, { integration: wsIntegration });` and collect each returned WebSocketRoute into an array `wsRoutes`. Keep the SAME wsIntegration for all routes (unchanged behavior: $connect returns 200, $default/actions dispatch to ws.ts).

Create the `wsStage` (apigwv2.WebSocketStage, stageName 'prod', autoDeploy: true) AFTER all routes are created, then add an explicit CloudFormation dependency from the stage to EVERY route: `for (const route of wsRoutes) { wsStage.node.addDependency(route); }`. This forces the AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage (and its AutoDeploy auto-deployment) to be created/updated only after all AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route resources exist, so the deployed prod stage always contains the full route set.

Add a clear, prominent code comment above this block explaining WHY (the API Gateway v2 WebSocket autoDeploy/route race: with autoDeploy:true CloudFormation does not implicitly order the auto-deployment after the Route resources, so without an explicit dependency the prod stage can be published with a missing/partial route set -> $connect not deployed -> handshake dropped at API Gateway -> browser close code=1006 and no $connect log in the ws Lambda). State explicitly that this dependency must NOT be 'simplified' away.

Preserve everything else in the block byte-for-byte in behavior: `wsIntegration` (WebSocketLambdaIntegration), `wsApi.grantManageConnections(wsFunction)`, the `wsFunction` definition and env vars, the WebSocketEndpoint CfnOutput using `wsStage.url`, and the stageName 'prod'. Do NOT change lambda/ws.ts, the frontend, package.json, or any lockfile.

Update test/quiz-app-stack.test.ts. Keep the existing 'defines the WebSocket routes ($connect/$disconnect/$default + actions)' and 'provisions a WebSocket stage' tests passing. Add a NEW test asserting the deterministic-deploy guarantee at the template level: find the AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage resource (via template.findResources('AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage')) and assert its CloudFormation `DependsOn` array includes the logical IDs of ALL WebSocket AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route resources (collect route logical IDs via template.findResources('AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route') filtered to the WS RouteKeys $connect/$disconnect/$default/createRoom/reattachRoom/joinRoom/startGame/submitAnswer/nextQuestion/endGame, then assert each such logical ID appears in the Stage's DependsOn). This test must FAIL if the addDependency wiring is reverted. Do not assert on specific generated logical-ID strings; derive them from findResources.

Add a short deploy note to README.md near the existing WebSocket/WS_URL deploy sections (around the 'デプロイ手順 (Deploy)' / WebSocketEndpoint notes). In Japanese to match the file, briefly explain: this fix makes all WebSocket routes deploy to the prod stage automatically on every `npx cdk deploy`; after merging, re-run `npx cdk deploy` (backend) so the prod stage picks up the routes and the realtime-battle close code=1006 / connection error is resolved; mention that a one-time manual 'Deploy API' in the API Gateway console is an immediate workaround but the CDK fix makes it permanent. Do not restructure the README; append a concise note.
acceptance_criteria: lib/quiz-app-stack.ts creates all 10 WebSocket routes ($connect, $disconnect, $default, createRoom, reattachRoom, joinRoom, startGame, submitAnswer, nextQuestion, endGame) and the wsStage carries an explicit CloudFormation dependency on every one of them, so the synthesized AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage DependsOn includes all AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route logical IDs.
The wsIntegration, grantManageConnections, wsFunction env vars, prod stageName, and WebSocketEndpoint CfnOutput (wsStage.url) are unchanged in behavior.
lambda/ws.ts, the frontend, package.json, and lockfiles are unchanged.
A prominent code comment documents the autoDeploy/route race and why the explicit dependency must remain.
test/quiz-app-stack.test.ts has a new test asserting the Stage DependsOn contains all WS Route logical IDs, and all existing WS-related assertions still pass logically.
README.md has a concise deploy note about re-running `npx cdk deploy` and the console 'Deploy API' one-time workaround.
verification: Sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY): read lib/quiz-app-stack.ts and confirm (a) all 10 routes are created via addRoute and captured, (b) wsStage.node.addDependency(route) is called for each, (c) the stage is created after the routes, (d) preserved elements intact. Reason through the synthesized template: the AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage will emit a DependsOn listing every Route logical ID.
Read the updated test and confirm it derives route logical IDs from template.findResources and asserts each is present in the Stage DependsOn (would fail if the dependency wiring were removed).

On the user's networked host: `npm ci && npm run build && npm test && npx cdk synth` all succeed; the new DependsOn test passes. After `npx cdk deploy`, connecting to wss://.../prod establishes the WebSocket (no close code=1006) and a $connect log appears in the ws Lambda CloudWatch log group.
findings: Implemented the deterministic WebSocket autoDeploy fix in lib/quiz-app-stack.ts: removed connect/disconnect/default RouteOptions from the WebSocketApi and created all 10 routes ($connect/$disconnect/$default + 7 actions) explicitly via wsApi.addRoute, capturing each WebSocketRoute into wsRoutes, then created the prod WebSocketStage (autoDeploy:true) and added wsStage.node.addDependency(route) for every route. This forces the AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage to carry a DependsOn on all Route logical IDs so the auto-deployment cannot publish before the routes exist. Preserved wsIntegration, grantManageConnections, wsFunction env vars, stageName 'prod', and the WebSocketEndpoint CfnOutput (wsStage.url). Added a new test in test/quiz-app-stack.test.ts asserting the Stage DependsOn contains all WS route logical IDs (derived via findResources, not hardcoded). Appended a Japanese README deploy note near the WS_URL section. lambda/ws.ts, frontend, package.json, lockfiles untouched. Could NOT run npm/tsc/jest/cdk in the sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: node_modules absent, npm registry 403) as documented in context.json; verified correct-by-construction against aws-cdk-lib 2.156 API and by reasoning about the synthesized CloudFormation dependency graph. User must run npm ci && npm run build && npm test && npx cdk synth && npx cdk deploy on a networked host.
